_comment: Example slot schema for a clinical deployment. Point VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA at a file like this.
Declaring a slot does three things: fixes its subject name so later statements about the
same thing reconcile instead of opening a second slot; tags every fact in it with a
category, which the critical-fact channel uses to bypass ranking; and marks values that
must be stored exactly as stated rather than normalized.
Set VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=critical so the tagged slots are always injected.

Slots marked "confirm" do not auto-apply a replacement or removal: the change is proposed, the current value stands, and a person approves it via confirm_change / reject_change. Use it where the WRITE is the hazard — an LLM reading 'we should stop the warfarin' is not an order to stop it.

Slots marked "multi" hold a LIST: allergies and the active medication list are several concurrent values, not one. A new distinct value ADDS to the list instead of replacing the others — without this, recording a second allergy silently deletes the first. Allergy is NOT confirm-gated because surfacing a newly discovered allergy is safety-positive and must be immediate; a medication change/stop still is.

slots.name: allergy
slots.description: a substance the patient reacts to, and the reaction (a patient may have several — this is a list)

slots.name: active_medication
slots.description: a medication the patient is currently taking, with dose and frequency

slots.name: code_status
slots.description: resuscitation preference — full code, DNR, DNI

slots.name: primary_diagnosis
slots.description: the principal condition currently being treated

slots.name: care_team_lead
slots.description: the clinician responsible for this patient's care
